description: Every city this pack has short-term rental (Airbnb) data for, from Inside Airbnb. Returns, per city: display name, country, currency the price fields are IN (prices are never converted -- each city's own local currency, e.g. CZK for Prague, not USD), how many listings are loaded, the overall median nightly price, and that city's OWN scrape date (data_as_of) -- coverage dates differ city to city because Inside Airbnb scrapes each one independently. Call this first if unsure whether a city is covered; str_city_summary and str_listings refuse an uncovered city by naming the covered set, but this is the smaller way to check.
name: list_str_cities
